Focusing on diversity over merit risks prioritising identity politics above the proven skills and cohesion needed to keep Britain competitive. I’m not denying diversity can bring innovation, yet an uncontrolled influx of workers often outpaces our ability to integrate them, straining resources and stunting real growth. Social cohesion fractures when people feel alienated in their own country, and strict border controls are the only way to manage immigration at a pace that allows proper integration.
